annotations.title: Show who I am connected as

description: Self-orientation for a fresh MCP session. Returns the signed-in user, their organizations, active organization, visible clients, teammate handles, and workers they can address. Call this first on a new connection to avoid guessing handles. Each client carries a team_summary — call list_client_team for the full roster before assigning work.
